To remain consistent with strict no-inference, I mark Net.Amount as 153,39 only if treating "MwSt.-frei" as explicit net value; otherwise leave empty. (Final extraction will choose the strict interpretation: only fields with clear explicit labels mapped to schema keys.)
- Number formatting: input uses comma as decimal separator "153,39". Schema requires number type; decimals must be preserved. Will convert to numeric with same decimal precision (153.39) in output.
